issue.title: InputItemModal and MacroItemModal are unreachable from production code since inline frontmatter cell editing

task_type_fields.impact: Dead TUI code that every macro-input change must keep compiling and testing; crashes in it go unnoticed by users.
task_type_fields.repro: Proposed by sase-1g4.3 note #5 (epic sase-1g4) and filed by the sase-1g4 land agent. `grep -rn "InputItemModal\|MacroItemModal" src/ --include=*.py` finds only their own modules, the lazy export table (src/sase/ace/tui/modals/_export_table.py) and styles.tcss. No production code constructs either modal. The frontmatter panel switched to inline cell editing in 7776f7a857 (2026-07-10, "add inline xprompt property editing"), which left both modals unreachable well before sase-1g4. Epic sase-1g4 still had to maintain them: it fixed an InputType NameError in InputItemModal (a958ba4e87) and added a choices editor. Decide whether to wire them back in or delete them. Deleting means removing both modules, their export-table entries, the .pyi stubs, their tcss rules, and their tests, then running Symvision.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1g4 kept fixing and extending two modals no production path opens; the dead code costs maintenance and hides crashes like the InputType NameError.
